subject: MAP pre-flight: ephemeral keys, org seeding, and controlled peering window
messages:
From: Claire Zhou <claire.zhou@orchidai.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2027 10:02:00 -04:00
Subject: POC environment: initial preflight questions

Jordan —

Great to meet you on the demo earlier. We're excited to move to a short POC to validate latency and inference cost with our data. The procurement team asked for a short mutual action plan so we can align on access windows. A few quick items from our side: 

- IP allowlist: we run services from 34.120.0.0/16 and 35.192.0.0/16 (GCP). What's the minimum ports/hosts you need?
- VPC peering: we prefer a one-week peering window for the evaluation (non-prod VPC). Any constraints?
- API keys / ephemeral tokens: for security we'd rather use short-lived tokens tied to specific environments. Can you confirm cadence and rotation approach?
- Org setup: can you create a sandbox org for us and seed a single service account?

I've attached our security questionnaire and the sections the infosec team will look at. If you can send a proposed MAP checklist and approximate calendar for key gates, we can map internal approvals.

Thanks,
Claire
Head of Platform | Orchid AI
--
Orchid AI

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhou <claire.zhou@orchidai.ai>, Max Turner <max.turner@orchidai.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC environment: initial preflight questions

Claire / Max —

Thanks for the clear list and the questionnaire — good starting point. Looping in Kimberly (Solutions) to validate the network windows. High-level responses and next steps below; I'll follow with a MAP draft (spreadsheet) and a short calendar for the 3-week evaluation.

Answers at a glance:
- IP allowlist: We'll provide a concise list of egress IPs (redwood-inference-prod and redwood-inference-staging pools) — typically a /32 per gateway for stable routing. For a POC we can provide a reduced set: 3 IPs per region.
- Ports: 443 outbound is sufficient for the API. If you plan to do VPC peering for private traffic we just need the peering CIDR and a maintenance window to provision routes.
- VPC peering: We support one-week peering windows. We'll request a single peering session and pre-create a peering accept on our side to shorten handoff. Note: peering requires your infra to accept routes; we'll specify the exact CIDR and routing rules in the MAP.
- API keys / ephemeral tokens: We can provision two short-lived (12 hour) ephemeral tokens for the trial environment plus one long-lived service account key for orchestration. Keys are delivered through our console; we also support HashiCorp Vault handoff if you prefer.
- Org setup: We will provision a sandbox org (org-id: orchid-poc-sandbox) and seed a 'service-poc' user with role limited to inference-only.

Next actions:
1) Kimberly to confirm exact egress IPs and provide a simple allowlist you can paste into your firewall.
2) I will attach a rough MAP spreadsheet with dates and gating items by EOD.
3) Security: we'll provide SOC2 excerpts and a Drive folder of artifacts.

Can you confirm your preferred peering CIDR and a proposed week (we suggested Aug 9-15 in the deck)?

Jordan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Jordan.Blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Claire / team —

Thanks — quick notes from the ops side and some gating constraints so we don't overcommit: 

- Egress IPs: For the US region POC we'll publish three stable egress IPs: 18.205.33.12, 18.205.33.13, 18.205.33.14. Use these for allowlist; they cover the staging cluster for the trial.
- Peering CIDR: We can peer to a /24 on your side; please confirm the target VPC CIDR. We need the peering request 48 hours before the maintenance window to provision routing and test.
- Maintenance window: recommend Tues-Thu 09:00-12:00 PT for the peering change to allow rollback the same day if needed. For Aug 9-15, we can host peering on Tue Aug 10.
- Keys: We'll generate two 12-hour ephemeral tokens and one non-rotating service account key for orchestrator use. Ephemeral tokens are rotated through our console and expire automatically. We'll provide a short runbook for token renewal.

I'll attach a one-page MAP checklist (redwood-map-draft.xlsx) with the gating steps and the proposed calendar. Jordan — feel free to edit dates.

Kimberly Park
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
